Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [해제] Essence Rend is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify once the target reaches the edge of the room. A Latent Cultist pool is left where it was removed.
[생존기] Soulcoil Rite goes off with every Phase 2 Invoke, so take a turn pre-spreading Atonement with Evangelism.
@m [참고] Spells being cast are interrupted the moment Invoke ends, so do not overlap long casts like Ultimate Penitence with that moment.

Entombed Sentinels: [해제] Blighted Blood is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Purify.
[광역 피해] While a Venom Coagulation ooze is alive, Contaminate hits the raid every 3 sec, so spread Atonement and heal by attacking the ooze.

Vashnik the Malignant: [해제] Dispelling Exploding Infection makes Caustic Explosion hit the whole raid, so do not clear several at once with Mass Dispel. Stagger them one at a time with Purify.
@m [생존기] Spread Atonement with Evangelism before Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion, which grow with each Imbibe.

The Lost Explorers: [해제] An Icebound Flames that slips past interrupts is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify.
[생존기] Spread Atonement with Evangelism before the window when Frostfire Volley debuffs are being cleared and before Fishy Feedback raid damage.
[탱버] When First Mate Nama's Steady Strikes stacks get high, reduce the tank's damage taken by 40% with Pain Suppression.

Sszorak: [탱버] Put Pain Suppression on the tank taking Ravage to reduce their damage taken by 40%.
[광역 피해] The whole raid takes damage when Venomous Surge ends, so spread Atonement with Evangelism before then.
[위치] When gathering in the middle before the Howling Maelstrom gusts, drop Angelic Feather to speed up late players.

The Twin Fangs: [생존기] Spread Atonement and line up Ultimate Penitence before the 6 sec of Stir the Depths raid damage and Venomous Emergence.
@m [탱버] Put Pain Suppression on the Ithraz tank stacking healing absorbs from Blood Torrent and strip the absorb with Penance.

The Coiled Altar: [생존기] Split Evangelism and Ultimate Penitence across the Veil of Twilight Suffocating Darkness and Defilement of the Coiled Altar healing absorb windows.
@hm [생존기] Venom Rupture DoTs stack up right after Sever pops the orbs, so spread Atonement before then.
[위치] When spreading past 40 yards after soaking Guillotine, drop Angelic Feather ahead for movement speed.

Ula'tek: [참고] Acidic Burst is a Poison, so Purify, which only removes Magic, cannot clear it. Leave poison dispels to another healer.
[생존기] Spread Atonement with Evangelism before the 20 sec of Rage of the Shackled raid damage and heal by attacking the exposed Venomous Heart.
[생존기] Phase 3 Fury Unleashed is heavy raid damage every second, so keep Ultimate Penitence for it.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [생존기] Spread Atonement with Evangelism before Unending Tides and Pop! raid damage.
[광역 피해] Pulsing Tides continues while a Bubblefin Berserker is alive, so keep Atonement up and attack the Bubblefin Berserker to heal and kill it at the same time.

Imperator Averzian: [생존기] Spread Atonement with Evangelism before Dark Upheaval at the pull and after each intermission.
[탱버] When Gnashing Void DoTs stack on the tank picking up adds under Weakened, reduce their damage taken by 40% with Pain Suppression.
@m [광역 피해] Heal through the 10 sec Lingering Darkness DoT on players dispelled of Void Marked with Penance.

Vorasius: [해제] The Blisterburst damage taken increase and the Creep Spit slow are Magic effects, so dispel them with Purify. If several players at the wall have them, clear up to 5 players within 15 yards at once with Mass Dispel.
[탱버] Put Pain Suppression on the tank with Smashed stacks when they take the second big claw impact.
@m [생존기] Spread Atonement with Evangelism before the first Blistercreep pack pops.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [생존기] The boss takes 25% more damage during Entropic Unraveling, so spread Atonement with Evangelism and heal by attacking with Ultimate Penitence.
[참고] Strip the Oppressive Darkness healing absorb from players coming out of Despotic Command with Penance.
[탱버] Put Pain Suppression on the tank taking Shattering Twilight by the wall.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [해제] Dread Breath fear is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify. If several players are caught in the cone, clear them at once with Mass Dispel.
[생존기] Part of the Midnight Flames damage gets through Radiant Barrier, so spread Atonement with Evangelism before then.
[참고] Heal through the healing absorb on the tank from Rakfang stacks with Penance.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [해제] The Avenger's Shield DoT is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Purify.
@m [해제] On Mythic, when Avenger's Shield targets every player, clear the DoTs from up to 5 players within 15 yards at once with Mass Dispel.
[분담] Focus heal players with the Tyr's Wrath healing absorb using Penance.

Crown of the Cosmos: [해제] Corrupting Essence on a player is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify.
[해제] Purifying Null Corona moves the absorb to someone else, so heal through it with Penance and only Purify in an emergency.
@nh [생존기] Put Pain Suppression on the tank that gets Gravity Collapse from breaking Aspect of the End.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [해제] Fearsome Cry fear that slips past interrupts is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Purify. If several players are affected, use Mass Dispel.
@hm [해제] Dispel Consuming Miasma with Purify once the target reaches an Alndust Essence pool.
[광역 피해] For the Rift Sickness healing absorb applied every time adds spawn, keep Atonement spread and attack the adds to strip several players at once.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [광역 피해] Heal off the Light Burn and Void Burn healing absorbs completely with Penance.
[생존기] Damage needs to go into the Phase 2 egg, so spread Atonement with Evangelism and attack the egg to heal and deal damage at the same time.
[탱버] Put Pain Suppression on the tank taking Light Edict or Void Edict.

Midnight Falls: [분담] Heal a Dusk Crystal to full with Penance to turn it into a Dawn Crystal.
@nh [해제] The stacking Safeguard buff is a Magic effect, so strip it with Dispel Magic. If the matrices are grouped, strip several at once with Mass Dispel.
[광역 피해] During Total Eclipse, strip the Eclipsed healing absorbs with Penance, prioritizing crystal carriers.

Rotmire: @hm [참고] The Poison Burst DoT is a Poison, so Purify, which only removes Magic, cannot clear it. Leave poison dispels to another healer.
[생존기] Rotting Pustules makes damage ramp up as the fight goes on, so stack Evangelism and Ultimate Penitence late in the fight.
[광역 피해] Attack the gathered Shroomlings and Bursting Shrooms with Atonement spread to heal the raid and kill them at the same time.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.

notes: Purify는 마법과 질병만 지워 Ula'tek 독 해제 불가
Power Word 계열은 이름에 쌍점이 있어 문장에서 제외, Void Shield 등 영웅 특성 한쪽 기술 제외
1시즌: 해제 줄은 digest 해제 목록(Magic)과 Purify·Mass Dispel·Dispel Magic 툴팁을 짝지었다. Void Marked와 Divine Shield는 해제 유형이 확인되지 않아 해제 줄로 쓰지 않았다.
1시즌: 영웅 특성 전용 기술(Entropic Rift 등)은 쓰지 않았다.
